title: [EPIC] Long-form writing mode — WriteFreely replacement
description: Add Medium/WordPress-style long-form writing to all three servers as a fieldwork capability. WriteFreely is the fediverse's blogging platform — federates articles as AP Article objects (not Notes). Supports custom CSS, anonymous blogs, and monetization stubs. Broadside: org blog/newsletter. Smallhold: personal blog with AP federation. Gaja: multi-tenant blogging platform (like write.as or Medium).
close_reason: WriteFreely API complete. P4 newsletter deferred to Sept.
